ConsolidatedReporting.Title: Consolidated reporting
ConsolidatedReporting.Description: A single view of your entire wealth — banks, custodians, real estate, private equity, collectible assets. Independent of any bank, with full transparency on performance and fees.

InvestmentOversight.Title: Investment oversight
InvestmentOversight.Description: Monitoring of mandates and managers, consolidated performance, fee and risk reviews, and preparation of your family investment committee. Oversight and coordination — never asset management.

FamilyOfficeCoordination.Title: Family office coordination
FamilyOfficeCoordination.Description: A single point of contact orchestrating bankers, lawyers, notaries, tax advisors and insurers — through to household management and special requests.

GovernanceSuccession.Title: Governance & succession
GovernanceSuccession.Description: Family charters, next-generation education, estate planning and succession coordination under Swiss law, with trust and foundation structures via established Swiss partners.

TaxAdministration.Title: Tax & administration
TaxAdministration.Description: Swiss tax compliance and optimisation — including lump-sum taxation — payroll for your employees and household staff, domiciliation, mail and administration.

RealEstateTransactions.Title: Real estate & transactions
RealEstateTransactions.Description: Property management and administration of your assets, sourcing and evaluation of opportunities, and transaction coordination with notaries, banks and due diligence.

DigitalVault.Title: Digital vault
DigitalVault.Description: An encrypted family document vault with Swiss data residency, structured records and controlled sharing with your advisors.
